description: This source file implements the WifiManagerEvents class, which manages registration and handling of WiFi-related system events via the IARM bus. It sets up event handlers during initialization, unregisters them during deinitialization, and processes specific WiFi state change, error, and SSID change events, forwarding these events to the WifiManager singleton.

classes.name: WifiManagerEvents
classes.description: Handles registration, unregistration, and processing of WiFi system events via the IARM bus. Utilizes callback functions to respond to system events and forwards these to the WifiManager singleton for further action.

methods.name: std::string Initialize(PluginHost::IShell *)
methods.description: Registers event handlers with the IARM bus for WiFi state changes, errors, and SSID list updates.

methods.name: void Deinitialize(PluginHost::IShell *)
methods.description: Unregisters previously registered event handlers from the IARM bus.

methods.name: void iarmEventHandler(char const * owner,IARM_EventId_t eventId,void * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Callback function that handles incoming system events related to WiFi, processes them, and calls corresponding methods on the WifiManager singleton.
